description: Comment on documents, spreadsheets, and web pages beside the chat, then hand every comment to an agent in one message. Select text in Markdown, PDF, Word, or PowerPoint files, box a chart on a page or slide, pick spreadsheet cells, or click any element of an HTML page; a comment on an area reaches the agent with an image of that region. Draw over a prototype or page to cross out a button, frame a block, or point an arrow to where it should move, and the agent gets the page as you saw it with your strokes on top. Each comment shows whether the agent closed it with a note on what changed or answered with a question, and a thread under it carries the conversation for as many rounds as it takes. In the bb desktop app, a Review button beside the browser's address bar puts the same comments on a live site, where they stay on their pages across reloads and deploys. Download a PDF with your comments as annotations any PDF viewer shows; Doc Review in another bb imports them, so a colleague can answer and send the file back. Files attached to chat messages open in the same tab, and the tab works in bb's mobile web app. Needs poppler-utils and LibreOffice on the machine the bb server runs on; Chrome or Chromium there adds the pictures of drawings on HTML pages.
